description: Cyclist occlusion conflict (edge case 05) on yale-street: car, truck, wrong-way cyclist and pedestrian replayed from the render timeline (scene-state.v1 sampled at 24 fps over 0..6 s; baked XODR heights, road + body attitude, wheel odometer) through `simforge-render job` (committed document lowered to the service stream with groundY 0: baked heights authoritative). Chase camera: the retired playback binary's follow camera on the first actor (delivery-truck). Ticks 0..119 render; tick 60 is hashed. Gates: pass hashes, a non-vacuous instance-ID pass, and observed actor transforms within the Bevy parity profile. The cyclist renders with its rider, posed from the timeline's wheelSpinRad odometer. Recorded substitution: the generic pedestrian.adult actor renders catalog walker walker.pedestrian.0015 (the model catalog/packs/starter-pedestrians maps pedestrian.adult to; pedestrians-carla has no pedestrian.adult entry and the service never substitutes).
